# cortex-ia

Cortex-IA is a deterministic Multi-Agent Control Plane, transactional installer, and orchestration engine for OpenCode and Herdr.

- **Planes Separation**:
  - Epistemic & Evidence Plane: Cortex MCP (`cortex_*` tools: AST graphs, blast radius, durable gotcha memory).
  - Control & Authority Plane: `cortex-ia work` (SQLite ACID DAG, CAS monotonic revisions, atomic file leases, peer review gates).
  - Specification Plane: OpenSpec (`openspec validate`, delta proposals, design, tasks DAG).
- **Core CLI Surfaces**:
  - `board`: `create`, `list`, `status`/`show`/`get`, `serve`
  - `work`: `create`, `list`, `status`/`show`/`get`, `claim`, `renew`, `lease`, `lease-renew`, `release`, `transition`, `approve`, `retry`, `recover`
  - `delegate`: `create`, `worker`, `status`, `result`, `cancel`, `recover`
  - `openspec`: `validate`, `list`, `status`
  - `web`: `--open`, `--addr` (real-time SSE web console)
  - `install`, `sync`, `doctor`, `mcp`, `rollback`, `uninstall`
- **Herdr Multiplexing**: Real-time NDJSON stream parsing, human-readable action summaries, live heartbeat spinners, and sub-second tool execution telemetry.
- **Safety Invariants**:
  - LockFileEx / flock cross-process file locks.
  - Verified snapshot backups before any disk write with automatic rollback.
  - Fail-closed path traversal and symlink checks.

Key documentation: README.md, docs/quickstart.md, docs/architecture.md, docs/agents.md, docs/sdd-workflow.md, docs/codebase/mcp-boundaries.md.
